togething.title: Togething
togething.description: Social React Native app for small wins, goal storylines, community support, and coaching — on the App Store and Google Play.
togething.longDescription: Togething is a community built to help people change their story through small steps and celebrated wins. Users create storylines, share steps, support each other, find accountability partners, and request coaching. Basic features are permanently free with no ads.

features.0: Storylines, shared steps, and positive social reinforcement
features.1: Accountability partners, groups, and real-time chat
features.3: Watching, daily steps, notifications, and watcher invites

results.0: Published on the App Store and Google Play
results.1: Improved screen load speed and reduced loading time by ~35%

damdast.title: Damdast | دم‌دست
damdast.description: Offline-first everyday utility app for Android and iOS, built with React Native and TypeScript.
damdast.longDescription: A multi-purpose daily utility app focused on UX, performance, and offline-first architecture. Published on Iranian app stores.

features.0: Personalized home and daily utility tools
features.1: Scanner, installments, work hours, and timers
features.2: Media compression, offline games, and music playback
features.3: Theming, RTL/LTR, app lock, backup, and gamification

results.0: Published on Cafe Bazaar and SibApp

portfolio-website.title: Web Portfolio
portfolio-website.description: Personal resume and portfolio website with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
portfolio-website.longDescription: Professional site showcasing experience, skills, and projects with modern React tooling.
portfolio-website.problem: Need a maintainable portfolio that reflects senior mobile and frontend experience.
portfolio-website.solution: Feature-oriented React app with typed content models, i18n, and a shared design system.

features.1: About, resume, skills, and projects pages
features.2: Light/dark theme, i18n, and validated forms

portfolio-website.architecture: Feature folders, typed data models, shared UI, and route-level code splitting.

challenges.0: Supporting RTL and LTR without layout regressions
challenges.1: Keeping architecture simple while remaining extensible
